findings.text: `bats_execute` now runs with `PATH="$BATS_SAVED_PATH"` instead of `$BATS_PATH`. Neither variable is defined anywhere in this directory, so I couldn't confirm that `BATS_SAVED_PATH` is ever set. If it is unset or empty, every command run through `bats_execute` (for example `bats_execute sort`) runs with an empty PATH and fails with 'command not found'. If it is set at a different time than `BATS_PATH`, it can also hold a PATH that already contains the test's mocks, which defeats the function's purpose.
